sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:72

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:72:1
items.html: From BON, Aba took the VAK of Hochma of BON, etc.: and one must understand well the reason for this order of division of MA and BON between the upper AVI and YESHSUT; and we have already explained this above (page 654, the passage beginning, “And indeed”), and from there you shall derive it.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:72:2
items.html: The five extremities of Bina of BON, which are the three lower ones, NHY: it should read, Gevura, Tifferet and the three lower ones, NHY.
